name: rt_password
description: Generate unique passwords or username-like strings locally with cryptographic randomness and printable ASCII character rules. Count is 1-100; total lengths include affixes and are 1-128. Generated values are shown only in the plugin panel, never returned to the model, including username mode. Arguments are visible to the model; do not pass secrets in character rules or affixes.

length.description: Total fixed length, also the default for omitted minLength/maxLength.

minLength.description: Defaults to length; with rangeLength, must not exceed maxLength.

maxLength.description: Defaults to length; every length in the selected range must be feasible.

username.description: Require an ASCII letter first. Generated values still stay in the panel.

specialChars.description: Printable ASCII special-character group; used when special is true.

customChars.description: Printable ASCII group replacing all built-in groups when customOnly is true.

extraChars.description: Additional printable ASCII alphabet characters, not a required group.

requireEach.description: Require each selected group; affixes may satisfy groups. Empty required groups are rejected.

prefix.description: Fixed printable ASCII prefix, included in total length and subject to exclusions.

suffix.description: Fixed printable ASCII suffix, included in total length and subject to exclusions.

name: rt_key
description: Generate unique cryptographically random secret keys locally. JWT HMAC minimums are 32 bytes for HS256, 48 for HS384, and 64 for HS512; generic minimum is 16 bytes. Maximum is 128 bytes, count 1-100. Encoded keys are shown only in the plugin panel and never returned to the model. This generates key material, not signed JWT tokens.

algorithm.description: HMAC algorithm for jwt purpose; accepted but unused for generic.

bytes.description: Omitted: 32 for generic/HS256, 48 for HS384, 64 for HS512. JWT minimum depends on algorithm.

name: rt_port
description: Sample unique random port numbers locally without replacement from an inclusive range (1-65535), optionally excluding common service ports and a comma-separated exclusion list/ranges. Returns the numbers to the model. Does not bind sockets, inspect the system, or guarantee that a suggested port is unused or unassigned by IANA.

max.description: Must be at least min and leave enough candidates for count.

exclude.description: Comma-separated ports or inclusive ranges, e.g. 3000,8080-8090; values must be 1-65535.

name: rt_uuid
description: Generate 1-100 unique cryptographically random UUID version 4 values locally in standard hyphenated or compact form, optionally uppercase. Values are returned to the model.

name: rt_hash
description: Hash UTF-8 text locally with SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, or MD5; return a hex or Base64 digest to the model. SHA-1 and MD5 are for compatibility, not security. Input is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Input and output enter the model conversation; use only non-sensitive text, never passwords, credentials, or tokens.

input.description: Non-sensitive text, at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes (runtime also checks byte size).

name: rt_timestamp
description: Convert an integer Unix timestamp to a date, or a strict ISO 8601 date with explicit timezone to timestamps, locally. Select seconds or milliseconds explicitly. Returns ISO, UTC, seconds and milliseconds in a JSON string inside values. Dates must be within +/-8640000000000000 milliseconds; seconds round down. Input and output enter the model conversation; use only non-sensitive text.

input.description: Integer text for toDate, or ISO 8601 with T and Z/explicit timezone for toTimestamp; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

name: rt_base64
description: Encode or decode Base64/Base64url locally with UTF-8 text or hexadecimal bytes. Reject invalid encoding, non-canonical trailing bits and invalid UTF-8 instead of silently repairing data. Input limit 65536 UTF-8 bytes; output limit 131072 bytes. Input and output enter the model conversation; encoding is not encryption, use only non-sensitive data.

input.description: Non-sensitive text/hex to encode, or Base64 to decode; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

format.description: Input format for encode; output format for decode.

name: rt_url
description: Parse an absolute HTTP(S) URL locally without network requests; preserve duplicate query entries and return protocol, hostname, port, path, query, fragment, origin and userinfo in a JSON string inside values. Input and all parsed fields enter the model conversation; never provide URLs containing real passwords, access tokens, or other private data. Input limit 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

input.description: Non-sensitive absolute HTTP(S) URL; no whitespace or backslashes; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

name: rt_jwt
description: Decode a non-sensitive sample JWT header and payload locally (three Base64url segments). Return the JSON objects with signatureVerified=false in a JSON string inside values. Does not verify signatures, trust claims, authorize, or judge expiration. Input token and decoded output enter the model conversation; never supply real authentication tokens. Input limit 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

input.description: Non-sensitive demonstration JWT only, never a real credential; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.
